journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

articles.title_en: Distributional Consequences of Policies for Electric Heat Conversion
articles.title_cn: 电力供暖转换政策的分配后果
articles.abstract_en: We study the adoption of air-source heat pumps for home heating. We estimate that 5% of already-built homes converted to heat pumps during 2010–20, while 22% of new homes built during this period chose heat pumps. New adoptions concentrate among rural households in the South. Conversions are more diffuse, covering urban and rural households in every region. Conversions are more prevalent in areas with mild winters and cheap electricity relative to other fuels but are less strongly associated with energy costs than adoptions in new homes. To better understand the distributional implications going forward, we calculate the annual energy-cost savings from switching to a heat pump for a large sample of US households based on their current heating fuels, climate, and local energy prices. We find massive variation, with low-income households in the Northeast and Appalachians benefiting the most.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了空气源热泵在家庭供暖中的采用情况。我们估计，在2010-20期间，已有住房中有5%转换为热泵，而在此期间新建住房中有22%选择了热泵。新采用集中在南部的农村家庭。转换则更为分散，覆盖了每个地区的城市和农村家庭。转换在冬季温和且电力相对于其他燃料便宜的地区更为普遍，但与能源成本的相关性不如新建住房中的采用那么强。为了更好地理解未来的分配影响，我们基于美国大量家庭当前的供暖燃料、气候和当地能源价格，计算了改用热泵后的年度能源成本节省。我们发现存在巨大差异，东北部和阿巴拉契亚地区的低收入家庭受益最大。

articles.title_en: Electric Vehicle Subsidies and Urban Air Pollution Disparities
articles.title_cn: 电动汽车补贴与城市空气污染差异
articles.abstract_en: Electric vehicles are subsidized at the federal, state, and local level. The design of these subsidies affects which consumers benefit most and where less-polluting vehicles are driven. We study these effects using a panel of new vehicle purchases at the zip-code level for seven US metro areas. We first describe patterns of neighborhood-level electric vehicle adoption and subsidy receipt. Adoption has been spatially uneven and concentrated in more advantaged and less polluted neighborhoods. We then pair a structural model of vehicle demand with a model of on-road emissions to study the effects of electric vehicle subsidy targeting for the Chicago metro area. A neighborhood income-targeted policy achieves lower overall reductions in carbon emissions but higher reductions in criteria pollution (NOx and PM2.5) in lower-income neighborhoods.
articles.abstract_cn: 电动汽车在联邦、州和地方层面均获得补贴。这些补贴的设计影响着哪些消费者受益最多，以及低污染车辆在何处行驶。我们利用美国七个大都市区邮政编码层面的新车购买面板数据来研究这些效应。我们首先描述了邻里层面电动汽车采用和补贴获取的模式。采用在空间上不均衡，并集中在更优越且污染更少的社区。然后，我们将汽车需求的结构模型与道路排放模型相结合，以研究芝加哥大都市区电动汽车补贴目标定位的效果。以邻里收入为目标的政策在碳减排总量上实现较低，但在低收入邻里实现更高标准的污染物（NOx和PM2.5）减排。

articles.title_en: Unequal Uptake: Assessing Distributional Disparities in the Residential Solar Market
articles.title_cn: 不平等的采纳：评估住宅太阳能市场中的分布差异
articles.abstract_en: We examine technology adoption and consumer welfare disparities across demographic groups using data from an online solar photovoltaic (PV) marketplace. Low-income households are 25% less likely to purchase solar through the platform and obtain 53% lower expected consumer surplus than high-income households. Moreover, Black and Hispanic households are relatively less likely to purchase solar through the platform and obtain lower consumer surplus than White and Asian households. We develop a method to decompose the drivers of consumer welfare disparities between demographic groups. Differences in demand fully account for the consumer surplus disparities between high- and low-income households and between White and Hispanic households. However, supply-side factors explain 37% of the consumer surplus gap between White and Black households. Black households get relatively fewer bids and face higher prices, and installers have higher implied costs to serve them. Finally, we assess counterfactuals that offer targeted price discounts to certain demographic groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用来自在线太阳能光伏（PV）市场的数据，考察不同人口群体之间的技术采纳和消费者福利差异。低收入家庭通过该平台购买太阳能的可能性比高收入家庭低25%，获得的预期消费者剩余低53%。此外，黑人和西班牙裔家庭通过该平台购买太阳能的可能性相对低于白人和亚裔家庭，获得的消费者剩余也更低。我们开发了一种方法，用于分解人口群体之间消费者福利差异的驱动因素。需求差异完全解释了高收入与低收入家庭之间以及白人与西班牙裔家庭之间的消费者剩余差异。然而，供给侧因素解释了白人与黑人家庭之间消费者剩余差距的37%。黑人家庭获得的报价相对较少，面临更高的价格，安装商为其提供服务的隐含成本也更高。最后，我们评估了向某些人口群体提供定向价格折扣的反事实情形。

articles.title_en: What Are the Likely Air Pollution Impacts of Carbon Capture and Storage?
articles.title_cn: 碳捕集与封存的可能空气污染影响是什么？
articles.abstract_en: We quantify the potential impacts of carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) on local air pollution in the US Gulf region. We characterize pre-CCUS local air pollution emissions from fossil-fuel electricity generation and large industrial carbon emitters and compare these with projected post-CCUS local air pollution emissions, leveraging carbon capture quotient estimates from the engineering literature. We then analyze net emissions impacts on secondary particulate matter formation and damages via the AP3 integrated air pollution assessment model. An important aspect of the environmental impact of CCUS is increased ammonia emissions from CCUS technology, which we show can lead to net air pollution damages from CCUS deployment at natural gas power plants and most industrial facilities. Taken as a whole, our work suggests that CCUS may pose significant trade-offs between global climate benefits and costs to local communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们量化了碳捕集、利用与封存（CCUS）对美国墨西哥湾地区当地空气污染的潜在影响。我们刻画了CCUS实施前化石燃料发电和大型工业碳排放源的当地空气污染排放，并利用工程文献中的碳捕集率估计，将这些排放与CCUS实施后的预计当地空气污染排放进行比较。随后，我们通过AP3综合空气污染评估模型分析了净排放对二次颗粒物形成及损害的影响。CCUS环境影响的一个重要方面是CCUS技术导致氨排放增加，我们表明这可能导致天然气发电厂和大多数工业设施部署CCUS产生净空气污染损害。总体而言，我们的工作表明，CCUS可能在全球气候效益与当地社区成本之间构成重大权衡。

articles.title_en: Distributional Impacts of Carbon Capture in the US Power Sector
articles.title_cn: 美国电力部门碳捕集的分配影响
articles.abstract_en: While some see carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) as crucial for cost-effective decarbonization, it faces opposition based on air pollution and equity concerns. To understand this cost–air pollution trade-off, we simulate the potential impacts of allowing CCUS deployment in the US power sector under plausible climate policies. We show that the existence of this trade-off critically depends on the underlying policy, which affects the type of generation CCUS could displace: under a policy that incentivizes coal generation, CCUS might improve health outcomes and reduce costs. When we disaggregate our results, we find that the air pollution (PM2.5) effects of allowing CCUS, positive or negative, are largest for Black and low-income populations. We show that allowing CCUS can yield energy-cost savings, particularly benefiting lower-income communities. Our sensitivity analyses highlight the effects of uncertainties on costs and benefits. Overall, this study contributes to our understanding of broader distributional consequences of allowing CCUS.
articles.abstract_cn: 虽然一些人认为碳捕集、利用与封存（CCUS）对于成本有效的脱碳至关重要，但它面临着基于空气污染和公平担忧的反对。为了理解这种成本—空气污染权衡，我们模拟了在合理的气候政策下允许CCUS在美国电力部门部署的潜在影响。我们表明，这种权衡的存在关键取决于基础政策，该政策影响CCUS可能替代的发电类型：在激励燃煤发电的政策下，CCUS可能改善健康结果并降低成本。当我们分解结果时，我们发现允许CCUS的空气污染（PM2.5）效应，无论是正面还是负面，对黑人和低收入人群最大。我们表明，允许CCUS可以产生能源成本节约，特别惠及低收入社区。我们的敏感性分析强调了成本和效益不确定性的影响。总体而言，本研究有助于我们理解允许CCUS的更广泛分配后果。

articles.title_en: Tax Credits for Clean Electricity: The Distributional Impacts of Supply-Push Policies in the Power Sector
articles.title_cn: 清洁电力税收抵免：电力部门供给侧推动政策的分配效应
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate distributional and efficiency consequences of the bulk power clean electricity tax credits authorized by the 2022 Inflation Reduction Act. To do so, we link detailed electricity capacity expansion, computable general equilibrium, microsimulation, and air pollution models to estimate economic welfare and health incidence across demographic groups. We evaluate trade-offs between policy efficiency and income progressivity by comparing the tax credits to cap-and-trade policies. The tax credits encourage increased clean electricity investment, resulting in a reallocation of capital from elsewhere in the economy, higher prices for capital and other goods, lower power prices, and lower emissions. The tax credits yield progressive outcomes for economic welfare at the expense of efficiency while all modeled policies demonstrate progressivity in health impacts. The health benefits, absent climate benefits, exceed total policy costs and provide greater benefits for low-income and historically marginalized households given coincidence of household locations and emissions exposure intensity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了2022《通胀削减法案》授权的批量电力清洁电力税收抵免的分配和效率后果。为此，我们链接了详细的电力容量扩展、可计算一般均衡、微观模拟和空气污染模型，以估计不同人口群体的经济福利和健康影响。我们通过将税收抵免与总量管制与交易政策进行比较，评估政策效率与收入累进性之间的权衡。税收抵免鼓励增加清洁电力投资，导致资本从经济其他部门重新配置，资本和其他商品价格上升，电力价格下降，排放减少。税收抵免在经济福利方面产生累进结果，但以效率为代价，而所有建模政策在健康影响方面均表现出累进性。健康收益（不包括气候收益）超过总政策成本，并且由于家庭位置与排放暴露强度的重合，为低收入和历史上边缘化家庭提供了更大的收益。

articles.title_en: Understanding the Inequality and Welfare Impacts of Carbon Tax Policies
articles.title_cn: 理解碳税政策的不平等和福利影响
articles.abstract_en: This study develops a general equilibrium life-cycle model to explore the welfare and inequality implications of different ways to return carbon tax revenue back to households. We find that the welfare-maximizing rebate uses two-thirds of carbon-tax revenue to reduce the distortionary tax on capital income while using the remaining one-third to increase the progressivity of the labor income tax. This recycling approach attains higher welfare and more equality than the lump-sum rebate approach preferred by policymakers as well as the approach originally prescribed by economists—which called exclusively for reductions in distortionary taxes.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究构建了一个一般均衡生命周期模型，以探讨将碳税收入返还给家庭的不同方式对福利和不平等的影响。我们发现，福利最大化的返还方式是将三分之二的碳税收入用于减少对资本收入的扭曲性税收，同时将剩余的三分之一用于提高劳动所得税的累进性。与政策制定者偏好的 lump-sum 返还方式以及经济学家最初提出的方式——该方式仅要求减少扭曲性税收——相比，这种循环利用方式实现了更高的福利和更多的平等。

articles.title_en: Distributional Equity in the Employment and Wage Impacts of Energy Transitions
articles.title_cn: 能源转型对就业和工资影响的分配公平性
articles.abstract_en: We use restricted-access, geocoded data on the near-universe of workers in 23 US states to quantify the impact of wind energy development on local earnings and employment, by race, ethnicity, sex, and educational attainment. We find significant impacts that persist for several years beyond the project construction phase. Our estimates are larger than those from previous studies but still small relative to typical economic multipliers for fiscal spending or investment in other industries. We find the largest percentage increases for black workers and workers who either do not have a high school diploma or who have a college degree. We also find the economic gains for men to be much larger than those for women. Finally, we find estimates from data aggregated to the county level to be significantly lower than our worker-level estimates. We suggest a number of areas for further study building off the justice implications of our findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用覆盖23个美国州近乎全体工人的受限访问地理编码数据，按种族、族裔、性别和教育程度量化风能开发对当地收入和就业的影响。我们发现显著影响在项目建设阶段之后持续数年。我们的估计值大于先前研究，但相对于财政支出或其他行业投资的典型经济乘数仍然较小。我们发现黑人工人以及没有高中文凭或拥有大学学位的工人的百分比增幅最大。我们还发现男性的经济收益远大于女性。最后，我们发现按县一级汇总数据的估计值显著低于我们的工人层面估计值。基于我们研究结果的正义含义，我们提出了一些有待进一步研究的领域。
